map.出租率与 RevPAR 计算 使用指南: Occupancy Rate and RevPAR Calculation User Guide
map.出租率与 RevPAR 计算器。输入售出/可用客房数与收入，按 OCC、ADR: Occupancy rate and RevPAR calculator. Enter sold and available room counts plus revenue to compute the occupancy rate (OCC), the average daily rate (ADR) and revenue per available room (RevPAR), used for hotel operating efficiency analysis.
map.可用客房数 = ADR × 出租率: Available rooms = ADR x occupancy rate
map.酒店每日经营复盘：输入可售房、已售房、房费收入，算出租率(OCC)、平均房价(A: Daily hotel operations review: enter available rooms, sold rooms and room revenue to compute the occupancy rate (OCC), average daily rate (ADR) and revenue per available room (RevPAR), judging whether to raise occupancy or the rate.
map.做收益管理决策时，对比「降价冲量」与「保价控量」对 RevPAR 的影响，选不伤: For revenue management decisions, compare the effect of "discount for volume" against "hold price and control volume" on RevPAR, and pick the plan that grows revenue without damaging the brand.
map.向投资人/业主汇报时，用 RevPAR 横向对标同档次竞品，说明经营效率。: When reporting to investors or owners, benchmark RevPAR against peers of the same tier to explain operating efficiency.
map.：OCC=已售/可售=90/120=75%；ADR=收入/已售=45000/90: OCC = sold/available = 90/120 = 75%; ADR = revenue/sold = 45000/90 = 500 CNY; RevPAR = revenue/available = 45000/120 = 375 CNY, and RevPAR = OCC x ADR = 75% x 500 = 375 CNY (the two forms are equivalent and cross-check each other). To raise RevPAR to 400, raise the rate to ADR of about 533 with occupancy unchanged, or lift OCC to 80% with ADR unchanged, which requires selling 6 more rooms.
map.RevPAR 和 ADR 有什么区别？: What is the difference between RevPAR and ADR?
map.ADR=已售房平均房价，只看「卖出的房」；RevPAR=总收入/全部可售房，把空: ADR is the average sold room rate and looks only at sold rooms; RevPAR is total revenue over all available rooms, spreading vacancy across them too, so it better reflects overall capacity utilization. Both being high is good; with a high ADR but low OCC, RevPAR can still be low.
map.可售房数包含自用房吗？: Does the available room count include self-use rooms?
map.不含。可售房=物理房量-维修/自用房-冻结房；RevPAR 分母用「真正能卖的房: Not included. Available rooms = physical rooms - maintenance/self-use rooms - frozen rooms; the RevPAR denominator should use the rooms that can really be sold, otherwise true performance is understated. This tool uses the available room count you enter.
